shared_elements: broad rounded head/shoulder mass of a monolithic figure seen from behind
pair of confronted bird-headed creatures in profile facing each other across the upper surface
vertical staff- or paddle-like objects with a face/head at the top (two, flanking)
small V- or crescent-shaped incised sign
low-relief incised carvings covering the upper back
narrow raised ridge/lip along the upper edge
justification: Both show the same distinctive scheme on the rear of a large blocky anthropomorphic monolith: two confronted bird-headed profile creatures at the top flanked by vertical paddle-like implements bearing faces, rendered in the same shallow, schematic low-relief with identical proportions and placement. The only difference in depicted content is coverage ":" A additionally shows the lower back with the ring/disc motif and arched bands, which B's closer view of the upper back omits.
